ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a speed-torque characteristic curve, with the vertical axis labeled speed (rpm), and the horizontal axis labeled torque (Nm). The solid line descends from the point of about 1500 rpm when the torque is 0, to the point of about 1400 rpm when the torque is 5 Nm; the dashed line also marks that T = 5 Nm corresponds to speed = 1400 rpm. Reasoning: The excitation voltage remains at the rated value, so the magnetic flux is constant. When rotational losses are ignored, the no-load torque is 0, therefore the no-load armature current is approximately 0, the armature voltage drop is 0, so the no-load back EMF E0 = V = 200 V. The no-load speed is 1500 rpm, namely ω0 = 1500 × 2π/60 = 157.08 rad/s. Therefore the motor constant K = E0/ω0 = 200/157.08 = 1.273. At 1400 rpm, the back EMF is proportional to speed: E = 200 × 1400/1500 = 186.67 V. The torque T = K Ia, so Ia = T/K = 5/1.273 = 3.927 A. The armature circuit satisfies V = E + Ia Ra, therefore Ra = (V − E)/Ia = (200 − 186.67)/3.927 = 3.39 Ω, approximately 3.4 Ω.

raw_record.question_text:
A separately excited DC motor runs at 1500 rpm under no-load with 200 V applied to the armature. The field voltage is maintained at its rated value. The speed of the motor, when it delivers a torque of 5 Nm, is 1400 rpm, as shown in the figure. The rotational losses and armature reaction are neglected.

The armature resistance of the motor is ______.

method.method_draft: Use the image to identify the two operating points: no-load 1500 rpm at T=0 and loaded 1400 rpm at T=5 Nm. From the text, V=200 V and field is constant. With no-load current negligible, set E0=200 V at 1500 rpm, so K=200/(1500·2π/60). At 1400 rpm, compute E=K(1400·2π/60), or equivalently E=200·1400/1500. Compute loaded armature current from Ia=T/K=5/K. Finally use Ra=(V−E)/Ia to obtain about 3.4 Ω.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图是速度-转矩特性曲线，纵轴标为 speed (rpm)，横轴标为 torque (Nm)。实线从转矩为 0 时约 1500 rpm 的点下降，到转矩 5 Nm 时约 1400 rpm 的点；虚线也标出了 T = 5 Nm 对应 speed = 1400 rpm。

推理：励磁电压保持额定值，所以磁通恒定。忽略旋转损耗时，空载转矩为 0，因此空载电枢电流近似为 0，电枢压降为 0，故空载反电势 E0 = V = 200 V。空载转速为 1500 rpm，即 ω0 = 1500 × 2π/60 = 157.08 rad/s。因此电机常数 K = E0/ω0 = 200/157.08 = 1.273。

在 1400 rpm 时，反电势与转速成正比：E = 200 × 1400/1500 = 186.67 V。转矩 T = K Ia，所以 Ia = T/K = 5/1.273 = 3.927 A。电枢回路满足 V = E + Ia Ra，因此 Ra = (V − E)/Ia = (200 − 186.67)/3.927 = 3.39 Ω，约为 3.4 Ω。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it plots speed versus torque with a straight line from 1500 rpm at T=0 to the dashed operating point 1400 rpm at T=5 Nm. Convert the no-load speed and speed drop to rad/s: ω0=1500·2π/60 and Δω=(1500−1400)·2π/60. From the text, V=200 V and losses are neglected, so K=V/ω0. Apply the slope formula Ra=K^2(Δω/ΔT), with ΔT=5 Nm. This yields Ra≈3.4 Ω.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图是速度-转矩特性曲线，纵轴标为 speed (rpm)，横轴标为 torque (Nm)。曲线是一条随转矩增大而下降的直线：在转矩 T=0 时速度约为 1500 rpm；图中用虚线标出了运行点，在 T=5 Nm 时速度为 1400 rpm。因此图像给出的速度降落为 1500−1400=100 rpm，对应转矩变化为 5 Nm。

推理：该电机为 separately excited DC motor，场电压保持额定值，所以磁通近似恒定，反电势常数和转矩常数 K 保持不变。忽略旋转损耗时，无载转矩为零，电枢电流近似为零，因此无载时反电势 E0≈V=200 V。

无载角速度：ω0 = 1500×2π/60 = 157.08 rad/s。
所以 K = V/ω0 = 200/157.08 = 1.273 V·s/rad。

速度降落：Δω = (1500−1400)×2π/60 = 100×2π/60 = 10.472 rad/s。
对于直流电机：V = Kω + IaRa，T = KIa。由速度降落关系可得 Δω = T Ra / K^2，因此 Ra = K^2(Δω/ΔT)。

代入 ΔT=5 Nm：Ra = (1.273)^2 × (10.472/5) = 3.40 Ω。

最终答案：3.4 Ω
